title: Fraction with Operators
hints: Normalize in the constructor so every other function can assume it: if `den < 0`, flip the sign of both; then divide both by `std::gcd(num, den)` from `<numeric>` (it works on absolute values, so a negative numerator is fine). Because `std::gcd(0, 5) == 5`, `0/5` becomes `0/1` for free.

`a/b + c/d = (a*d + c*b) / (b*d)`. Build `Fraction(a.num() * b.den() + b.num() * a.den(), a.den() * b.den())` and let the constructor reduce it. Since every Fraction is normalized, `==` is just `a.num() == b.num() && a.den() == b.den()`.
